The season will begin on 15 August 2026 and will finish in May 2027. ==Teams== The leаgue consists of ten teams: the top eight teаms from the previous season, and two teams promoted from the [[First Football League of Kosovo|Kosovo First League]]. [[FC Drita|Drita]] enters the season as defending champions.{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://insajderi.org/en/The-big-celebration-of-light-after-defending-the-championship-title-in-the-Super-League-video/|title=Drita's big celebration after defending the Super League championship title/VIDEO|language=English|website=insajderi.org|date=9 May 2026}} The promoted teаms are the 2024–25 Kosovo First League winners [[FC Vushtrria|Vushtrria]], who return to the top tier after their last relegation in 2021,{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.koha.net/en/futboll/vushtrria-kampione-ne-ligen-e-pare-kthehet-ne-superlige-pas-gjashte-vjetesh|title=Vushtrri returns to the Super League after six years|language=English|website=koha.net|date=23 May 2026}} and First League runners-up [[FC Feronikeli 74|Feronikeli]], who only spend one season in the second tier.{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://reporteri.net/en/sport/Feronikeli-returns-to-the-Super-League--wins-against-Ramiz-Sadiku-and-secures-promotion/|title=Feronikeli returns to the Super League, wins against Ramiz Sadiku and secures promotion|language=English|website=reporteri.net|date=23 May 2026}} They replaced the [[2025–26 Football Superleague of Kosovo|2025–26 Kosovo Superleague]] bottom two
